component.name: Compare All
component.summary: Compare and merge files and folders

description.p: Compare All compares files and folders. It shows the differences side by side. It can also merge, synchronize, and edit.

ul.li: Text compare and two-way or three-way text merge
Table compare for CSV and other delimited data
Picture compare with marked pixel differences
Version compare and media tag compare

description.p: A side of a comparison can be a local path, an archive, or a remote location.
